color_palette.text: 大面积低饱和冷灰蓝构成背景，小面积琥珀暖色只强调中文标题及其邻近的一小处亮面。

edge_control.text: 标题的关键字形边缘最清楚，五个阶段的标签与主路径均保持可读，外围色面以低对比断边融接。

detail_density.text: 标题区域承接最集中的表现细节，流程区用克制的排版与线条承载完整信息，外围保留大块低密度留白。

subject.text: 制作一张用于课堂展示的五阶段设计流程信息图。

visual_path.text: 先读唯一暖点的标题，用低反差空间线索引入主路径，随后按五节点顺序阅读。反馈虚线保持从属。

protected_items.text: 用一条清楚可追踪的实线箭头主路径连接且只连接五个阶段。标名顺序为 Brief → Research → Study → Proposals → Delivery，各阶段可独立辨读。
仅用一条独立细虚线箭头从 Proposals 指向 Study，在边侧标注「反馈示意」，将其作为图面可见的示意回返。

negative_constraints.text: 采取等权可读的节点，间距服务版面。排除无来源的日期、时长、工作量、数值刻度和因果说明。

color_palette.text: Use broad low-saturation cool blue-gray for the background; limit the small amber accent to the Chinese headline and a tiny adjacent light patch.

edge_control.text: Keep the headline glyph edges clearest, all five labels and the main line legible, and merge peripheral masses with low-contrast broken edges.

detail_density.text: Concentrate the expressive detail in the title area, retain the complete process information in restrained typography and lines, and leave broad low-density space around it.

subject.text: Create a five-stage design process infographic for classroom presentation.

visual_path.text: Start at the headline as the only warm focus. Use low-contrast spatial cues to lead into the main chain, then read the five nodes in order, with the dashed feedback line subordinate.

protected_items.text: Connect exactly five readable stages with one traceable solid-arrow chain, in this exact order: Brief → Research → Study → Proposals → Delivery.
Add a single separate thin dashed arrow from Proposals back to Study. Place the exact label “反馈示意” next to the arrow and treat it as an illustrative return inferred from the diagram.

negative_constraints.text: Give the stage nodes equal visual readability and use spacing for layout. Omit unsourced dates, durations, workload measures, numeric axes and causal claims.
